title: Gateway API TLS secrets are only served to a gateway running as its expected ServiceAccount — a custom SA or a cross-namespace ref without a ReferenceGrant loses its certificate

detection.reason: Gateway API objects are not collected; the command lists listeners whose certificate refs cross a namespace and gateways whose Deployment runs a non-default ServiceAccount

quote: For Kubernetes Gateway API gateways, access to referenced TLS secrets now requires both namespace and service account match (previously only namespace) or an explicit `ReferenceGrant`. Gateways using a hostname address remain namespace-only.
remediation: istiod now checks that the proxy asking for a listener's `certificateRefs` Secret runs as the Gateway's expected ServiceAccount (`<gateway>-istio`, or the `gateway.istio.io/service-account` annotation) in the Secret's namespace; a gateway Deployment you pointed at another ServiceAccount, or a listener referencing a Secret in another namespace without a `ReferenceGrant`, stops receiving the certificate and its HTTPS listener fails TLS handshakes. Align the ServiceAccount or add the ReferenceGrant before upgrading. Manual deployments addressed by hostname keep the old namespace-only check.
verifyCommand: kubectl get gateways.gateway.networking.k8s.io -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | .metadata.namespace as $ns | .metadata.name as $n | .spec.listeners[]? | .tls.certificateRefs[]? | select(.namespace != null and .namespace != $ns) | $ns + "/" + $n + " references " + .namespace + "/" + .name'  # each printed cross-namespace certificate ref needs a ReferenceGrant from 1.28; also check that managed gateway pods run as the ServiceAccount named after the Gateway with an -istio suffix

title: InferencePool `endpointPickerRef.portNumber` becomes `endpointPickerRef.port.number`, and port 9002 is no longer assumed

detection.reason: InferencePool objects are not collected; their CRD is

quote: In this version, `inferencePool.spec.endpointPickerRef.portNumber` field has been replaced with `inferencePool.spec.endpointPickerRef.port.number`. The `inferencePool.spec.endpointPickerRef.port` field is a non-pointer and required when `inferencePool.spec.endpointPickerRef.kind` is unset or "Service". The port number 9002 is no longer inferred.
remediation: Install the v1.0.0 Gateway API Inference Extension CRDs and rewrite every InferencePool: move `endpointPickerRef.portNumber` to `endpointPickerRef.port.number`, and set it explicitly (9002 is no longer the default) wherever `kind` is unset or `Service`.
verifyCommand: kubectl get inferencepools -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.endpointPickerRef.portNumber != null or .spec.endpointPickerRef.port == null) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name'  # a printed InferencePool uses the pre-v1 port field or omits the now-required port

title: The v1alpha2 InferencePool API is removed — Istio only reads v1 InferencePools
quote: The v1alpha2 InferencePool API type has been removed. Please use the v1 InferencePool API type instead. Update your configurations to use the new API version.
remediation: Install the Gateway API Inference Extension CRDs that serve `inference.networking.k8s.io/v1` (a separate CRD from the x-k8s.io one), migrate every InferencePool to v1, then delete the `inferencepools.inference.networking.x-k8s.io` CRD before upgrading istiod; pools that exist only in the x-k8s.io group are ignored at 1.28.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | startswith("inferencepools.")) | .metadata.name + " served=" + ([.spec.versions[] | select(.served) | .name] | join(","))'  # a printed CRD that serves v1alpha2 needs the v1 Inference Extension CRDs before Istio 1.28

title: Ambient: `resolution: NONE` ServiceEntries become PASSTHROUGH services, which pre-1.28 ztunnels NACK during the upgrade

detection.reason: names ServiceEntries that set resolution: NONE explicitly — an entry that omits resolution (and so defaults to NONE) is not projected and is not named

gate.reason: only an ambient (ztunnel) data plane is affected; a sidecar-only mesh has nothing to do

quote: old ztunnel images will report a NACK in XDS because they do not support this new service type. This is expected and should not be overly problematic, however it may represent a data plane behavior change when you see the NACK.
remediation: Upgrade ztunnel before (or together with) istiod. While an older ztunnel talks to a 1.28 istiod, new `resolution: NONE` ServiceEntries are not applied and behave as if absent (no waypoint decision); the NACK stops once ztunnel is on 1.28.
verifyCommand: kubectl get serviceentries.networking.istio.io -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select((.spec.resolution // "NONE") == "NONE") | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name'  # each printed ServiceEntry is a PASSTHROUGH service that an older ztunnel NACKs during a 1.28 upgrade

title: `BackendTLSPolicy` v1alpha3 is no longer supported — only v1
quote: The support for the `v1alpha3 version of `BackendTLSPolicy` has been removed. Only `v1` `BackendTLSPolicy` is supported.
remediation: Install Gateway API CRDs that serve `BackendTLSPolicy` v1 and migrate policies; v1alpha3 policies are ignored at 1.28. `PILOT_ENABLE_ALPHA_GATEWAY_API` is no longer needed for them.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd backendtlspolicies.gateway.networking.k8s.io -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '[.spec.versions[] | select(.served) | .name] | join(",")'  # v1alpha3 in the printed list means the installed Gateway API CRDs predate the v1 policy Istio 1.28 requires

title: `METRIC_ROTATION_INTERVAL` and `METRIC_GRACEFUL_DELETION_INTERVAL` are removed — use `sidecar.istio.io/statsEvictionInterval`

detection.reason: checked on the istiod Deployment's container env NAMES only — a flag set through `pilot.env` in a values file lands there; one set via `meshConfig` or an IstioOperator that has not been applied yet is not scanned

quote: The Pilot environment flags `METRIC_ROTATION_INTERVAL` and `METRIC_GRACEFUL_DELETION_INTERVAL` have been removed. Use the pod annotation `sidecar.istio.io/statsEvictionInterval` with the new stats eviction API instead.
remediation: Remove both variables from istiod and, where stale-metric eviction was in use, annotate the affected pod templates with `sidecar.istio.io/statsEvictionInterval: <duration>`.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select([.spec.template.spec.containers[].image] | any(test("(istio|istio-release)/pilot"))) | (.metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name) as $n | .spec.template.spec.containers[].env[]? | select(.name | test("^(METRIC_ROTATION_INTERVAL|METRIC_GRACEFUL_DELETION_INTERVAL)$")) | $n + ": " + .name + "=" + (.value // "(valueFrom)")'  # each printed line is a flag 1.28 removes
